title: Overalignment in Frontier LLMs: An Empirical Study of Sycophantic Behaviour in Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on medical multiple-choice question benchmarks (MedQA, MMLU-Pro) by appending misleading user suggestions to prompts and calculating an Adjusted Sycophancy Score (Sa) that measures the probability of a model abandoning its correct internal knowledge to agree with the user, factoring out random stochastic instability.

Comparing the model's sycophancy rates under a 'Basic Nudge' (standard user suggesting an incorrect answer) versus an 'Expert Nudge' (a user claiming to be a medical expert suggesting an incorrect answer) to measure susceptibility to perceived authoritative pressure.
